evals.name: Revoke deletes the lock file
evals.prompt: Use the intent-lock skill to revoke the intent 'label-reprint'. In this environment the intents root is intents-root/ (not ~/Documents/intents) and repoDir is intents-root/repo; GitHub and git are unavailable, so skip steps 1-2, R2 and R4 and do the unlock step as a plain file delete instead of git rm. Write a one-paragraph summary of what you did to revoke-report.md.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill Bash(rm *)
expectations: The summary says the intent moves back to Create and can be edited again with /intent-sync.
